subject: Finova: Decision criteria & SLA clarification - latency, cost, deployment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finova.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Finova kickoff — decision criteria & immediate clarifications

Hi Priya / Alex —

Thanks again for the call today — great context on Finova's use cases (customer service triage + internal doc search) and the reliability constraints you called out. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture the open questions so we can move the procurement and technical evaluation in parallel: 

1) Decision / SLA targets you mentioned:
   - Latency: target p95 end-to-end generation latency <= 300ms for typical single-turn queries (~256 tokens). We noted some calls are latency-sensitive (chat UI) and others are batch/async (embeddings).
   - Cost: target unit economics below ~$0.10 per 1k generated tokens at projected volumes (Q1 estimate) — happy to model multiple scenarios.
   - Deployment: you indicated a preference for Dedicated (reserved capacity) for production due to data isolation, but the security team may ask for a Private/VPC option for certain workloads.

2) Buying process & stakeholders:
   - Economic buyer / final approver: Alex (please confirm if that's correct).
   - Procurement / legal cycle: procurement@finova.com will run the contract review — tentative timeline of 6–8 weeks once SOW/terms are agreed.
   - Security checklist: David (Redwood) will coordinate directly with your security team on SOC2, data retention, and encryption requirements.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll share a short SOW + SLA summary (attached) and a draft PoC test plan.
- Rishi (SE) to run a technical deep-dive (performance targets and sample workload) — can we aim for a 60-minute call next week?
- Priya/Alex: confirm economic buyer and procurement timeline so we can align internal approvals.

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB); poC-test-plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 35KB)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0119

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finova.com>, procurement@finova.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finova kickoff — decision criteria & immediate clarifications

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — helpful. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- Economic buyer: yes, Alex Mercer (CTO) is the final decision owner for this project. He will also loop in the Head of Ops for budget signoff for Q1.
- Latency: target is p95 <= 250–300ms for interactive queries up to ~256 tokens. For embeddings and bulk reranking we care more about throughput than strict p95.
- Cost: our finance team is targeting a vendor unit cost that results in <25% increase over our current spend on inference (we can provide current figures under NDA). For planning, please include a few cost scenarios (PoC, baseline projected, and peak).
- Deployment: production must run on Dedicated reserved capacity; for any PII workflows the security team will require Private/VPC options and a DPA.
- Security/procurement timeline: procurement estimates 6 weeks for standard SaaS terms + 2 additional weeks for any required legal redlines. They will need SOC2 Type II report, encryption at rest details, and a short list of subprocessor locations.

We're available for a technical deep-dive next Tue/Wed morning PT — can Rishi send suggested times?

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of Product, Finova
priya.shah@finova.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finova.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, procurement@finova.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finova kickoff — decision criteria & immediate clarifications

Great — thanks for confirming, Priya. 

Rishi, David — looping you both in: would like to set up two short sessions next week:
  1) Technical deep-dive (60m): sample queries, target p95 <= 300ms (aim for <=250ms), dataset size for PoC, acceptance criteria.
  2) Security intake (30m): SOC2 artifacts, encryption/KMS, retention & deletion policies, subprocessor locations.

I've attached a lightweight "security + SLA" summary that covers our standard guarantees and the SOW draft. If procurement needs alternative language we can pre-fill common redline suggestions to accelerate review.

Proposed times (PT): Tue 11/24 10:00–11:00 or Wed 11/25 09:00–10:00. Priya/Alex — which works best?

Attachments: security-sla-summary.pdf (application/pdf, 80KB); SOW-draft-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB); poC-test-plan.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finova.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finova kickoff — decision criteria & immediate clarifications

Thanks — happy to run the tech deep-dive. Quick PoC plan outline to align expectations before the call: 

PoC objectives:
- Validate p95 latency target for interactive UI: target p95 <= 250ms for 95% of traffic under a simulated single-tenant reserved-capacity workload.
- Validate cost model at projected Q1 baseline (we'll run synthetic traffic to estimate token costs).
- Verify embedding throughput & reranking latency for batch jobs (throughput targets TBD with your team).

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- p95 generation latency <= 300ms; aim <=250ms on dedicated capacity for 256-token prompts.
- Error rate < 0.5% over a 24h window during controlled tests.
- Telemetry: token-level latency histograms, per-route cost estimates, KV cache hit rate.

What we need from Finova before the call:
- Representative sample prompts and 1–2 example threads that mirror production traffic (anonymized if needed).
- Expected Q1 RPS and peak RPS to size the Dedicated pool for the PoC.
- Any PII flags for data that must be kept on Private/VPC.

I'll attach a simple test matrix (poC-test-plan.xlsx) and can walk through it. Proposed times look good — I prefer Wed 11/25 09:00 PT.

—Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.com>, procurement@finova.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finova kickoff — decision criteria & immediate clarifications

Hi Priya / procurement team —

I'll own the security intake. I have the SOC2 Type II report and our standard DPA templates; happy to share immediately following an NDA if needed. A couple of quick notes: 

- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit; KMS integration is supported for Private deployments.
- Data retention: configurable per-customer retention windows; we can support 30/90/365-day policies and provide deletion confirmation logs.
- Subprocessors: hosted region details and third-party infra vendors listed in the attached summary.

If procurement can share a sample contract or preferred redlines ahead of the review, I can pre-check and flag any items that need legal attention.

Attachments: security-sla-summary.pdf

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com
